prior_work_direct.representative: Vladimirov & Volovich, Comm. Math. Phys. 123 (1989) — p-adic quantum mechanics
prior_work_direct.coverage: Established field since 1980s. p-adic wavefunctions, p-adic path integrals, adelic string theory. Uses p-adic numbers as configuration space, not frequency-as-valuation identity.
prior_work_direct.gap: Existing work uses p-adic numbers as a MODEL (an alternative number field for quantum theory), not as the INTRINSIC valuation-theoretic structure of frequency itself. Our claim is stronger: frequency IS already a rational valuation object; the p-adic completions are its NATIVE structure, not an imposed model.

prior_work_direct.coverage: Well-established that Planck units make all quantities dimensionless. But this is treated as a convenience, not an ontological claim about the number system.
prior_work_direct.gap: No prior work claims that the resulting dimensionless numbers are specifically RATIONAL (as opposed to real). The rational claim is novel.

prior_work_direct.category: Natural units / Planck units as fundamental
prior_work_direct.representative: Wilczek, 'On Absolute Units', Physics Today (2005, 2006, 2007 series)
prior_work_direct.coverage: Discusses Planck units as natural, but treats quantities as real numbers. No valuation-theoretic analysis.
prior_work_direct.gap: QNFO ODR thesis (Zenodo 21756190, 21758752) already covers dimensionless reformulation + Bruhat-Tits tree. Our paper provides the frequency-specific formalization.

prior_work_direct.coverage: The Compton frequency as internal clock is an old idea. de Broglie's 'internal clock' hypothesis. Hestenes' Zitterbewegung interpretation.
prior_work_direct.gap: No prior work treats the Compton frequency as a VALUATION-THEORETIC object with p-adic completions. The rational-ratio claim with prime spectrum is novel.

prior_work_direct.representative: Koide, Lett. Nuovo Cim. 34 (1982) — charged lepton mass formula; many rational mass ratio speculations
prior_work_direct.coverage: The idea that particle mass ratios might be exact rational numbers has a long history. Koide formula is the most famous empirical pattern.
prior_work_direct.gap: Koide and similar work treats mass ratios as real-valued coincidences. Our framework provides a structural justification (frequency = rational valuation) for WHY they should be rational, not real.

constraints.claim: Particle masses are exactly rational in Planck units
constraints.constraint: All particle masses are known only to finite precision. No experimental evidence that m_e/m_P is rational vs. irrational. CURRENTLY UNFALSIFIABLE at experimental precision.
constraints.status: [not yet falsifiable — acknowledged in core claim]

constraints.claim: Spacetime is fundamentally discrete at Planck scale
constraints.constraint: No experimental evidence for discrete time. Planck time is 5.39e-44 s, far below any direct probe. This is an ASSUMPTION of the framework.

constraints.claim: The product formula acts as a dynamical law
constraints.constraint: Tate's product formula ∏|q|_v = 1 is a mathematical identity, not a dynamical equation. The leap from 'static identity' to 'conservation law that generates dynamics' requires additional structure not yet specified.

novelty_assessment.overall: The paper's core novelty claim is: (1) frequency specifically as valuation-theoretic object (not just 'p-adic physics' generically), (2) Compton frequency as prime spectrum of particle identity, (3) the rational-ratio claim that dimensionless frequencies are in Q, not R. None of these specific claims appears in the external literature.
novelty_assessment.differentiation_from_odr: Existing ODR papers (21758752, 21756190, 21777500) establish the Bruhat-Tits coordinate system, dimensionless mandate, and Compton-count-as-primitive. This paper provides the FREQUENCY-SPECIFIC valuation-theoretic bridge — explaining WHY Compton counting works by showing that frequency is already a rational valuation.
novelty_assessment.risk: Medium — the claim that masses are rational is empirically indistinguishable from real-valued masses at current precision. The paper must derive falsifiable consequences beyond 'they're rational' to be scientifically meaningful.
